examples.en: The manager wants to see which way the wind blows before changing the plan.
examples.zh: 經理希望先看清大家的取向，再修改計劃。

examples.en: We can already see which way the wind blows among the younger customers.
examples.zh: 我們已經可以看出年輕顧客的整體取向。

meaning.en: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.
meaning.zh: 了解某個情況、輿論或一群人的取向正朝哪個方向發展，尤其是在作出決定前先探清形勢。

register.summaryEn: journalism; general-interest writing; discussions about public opinion; decisions involving a group; comments about changing trends.
register.summaryZh: 日常對話； 職場討論； 會議； 新聞報道； 一般文章； 討論公眾意見； 涉及群體的決定； 評論不斷轉變的趨勢。
register.formalEn: Use the idiom only in the contexts described in the source.
register.formalZh: 這個表達屬於中性至非正式語域。

fixedVariable.fixedEn: Keep the fixed words and word order shown in the source expression.
fixedVariable.fixedZh: 保留原檔目標表達中的固定字詞及字序。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Change only the verb form, possessive, tense or surrounding grammar permitted by the source patterns.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 只按照原檔句式改變動詞形式、所有格、時態或前後文法。

forms.form: Subject + see(s) / saw / can see + which way the wind blows.
forms.example: The manager wants to see which way the wind blows before changing the plan.

forms.form: Subject + know(s) / knew / wants to know + which way the wind blows.
forms.example: The chairperson wants to know which way the wind blows before calling a vote.

forms.form: Subject + can / cannot + tell / sense / judge + which way the wind blows.
forms.example: Can you tell which way the wind blows from these comments?

forms.form: Subject + find(s) out / work(s) out / discover(s) + which way the wind blows.
forms.example: The organiser sent a survey to find out which way the wind blows among the volunteers.

forms.form: Subject + wait(s) / waited / will wait + to see + which way the wind blows.
forms.example: We should wait to see which way the wind blows before choosing a date.

forms.form: a sign / sense / idea / picture + of + which way the wind blows
forms.example: The first vote gave us an idea of which way the wind blows.

forms.form: Subject + depend(s) / may depend + on + which way the wind blows.
forms.example: The final decision may depend on which way the wind blows in tomorrow’s vote.

forms.form: Which way the wind blows + verb

examples.en: The manager wants to see which way the wind blows before changing the plan.
examples.zh: 經理希望先看清大家的取向，再修改計劃。

examples.en: We can already see which way the wind blows among the younger customers.
examples.zh: 我們已經可以看出年輕顧客的整體取向。

specificForms.formula: Subject + know(s) / knew / wants to know + which way the wind blows.

examples.en: Nobody yet knows which way the wind blows among the undecided members.
examples.zh: 目前仍沒有人知道尚未表態的成員傾向哪一方。

specificForms.titleZh: 三、放在 tell、sense 或 judge 之後
specificForms.formula: Subject + can / cannot + tell / sense / judge + which way the wind blows.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Subject + can / cannot + tell / sense / judge + which way the wind blows.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Subject + can / cannot + tell / sense / judge + which way the wind blows。

examples.en: Can you tell which way the wind blows from these comments?
examples.zh: 你可以從這些評論判斷大家的取向嗎？

examples.en: It is difficult to judge which way the wind blows from only three replies.
examples.zh: 單憑三個回覆，很難判斷整體意見的方向。

specificForms.formula: Subject + find(s) out / work(s) out / discover(s) + which way the wind blows.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Subject + find(s) out / work(s) out / discover(s) + which way the wind blows.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Subject + find(s) out / work(s) out / discover(s) + which way the wind blows。

examples.en: The organiser sent a survey to find out which way the wind blows among the volunteers.
examples.zh: 主辦人發出問卷，以了解義工的整體取向。

examples.en: She is trying to work out which way the wind blows before announcing her decision.
examples.zh: 她正嘗試探清形勢，再公布決定。

specificForms.titleZh: 五、放在 wait to see 之後
specificForms.formula: Subject + wait(s) / waited / will wait + to see + which way the wind blows.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The expression wait to see often suggests that the speaker is delaying a decision until the situation becomes clearer.
specificForms.descriptionZh: wait to see 通常表示說話者暫緩決定，直至形勢變得更明朗。

examples.en: We should wait to see which way the wind blows before choosing a date.
examples.zh: 我們應先看看大家傾向哪個日期，再作選擇。

specificForms.formula: a sign / sense / idea / picture + of + which way the wind blows
specificForms.descriptionEn: The phrase of which way the wind blows describes what the sign, idea or picture reveals.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 說明某個跡象、概念或整體畫面反映了甚麼。

examples.en: The first vote gave us an idea of which way the wind blows.
examples.zh: 第一次表決讓我們初步了解大家的取向。

examples.en: The comments provide a clear picture of which way the wind blows among customers.
examples.zh: 這些評論清楚反映顧客的整體取向。

specificForms.titleZh: 七、放在 depend on 之後
specificForms.formula: Subject + depend(s) / may depend + on + which way the wind blows.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Subject + depend(s) / may depend + on + which way the wind blows.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Subject + depend(s) / may depend + on + which way the wind blows。

examples.en: The final decision may depend on which way the wind blows in tomorrow’s vote.
examples.zh: 最終決定可能視乎明天表決時大家的取向。

examples.en: The manager’s response often depends on which way the wind blows among senior staff.
examples.zh: 經理的回應往往取決於高級員工的整體取向。

specificForms.titleEn: As the Subject of a Sentence
specificForms.formula: Which way the wind blows + verb
specificForms.descriptionEn: This pattern is grammatically correct but less conversational. It is most suitable for later questions and written discussion.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個句式文法正確，但口語感較低，較適合後段題目及一般書面討論。

examples.en: Which way the wind blows is still unclear.
examples.zh: 大家的取向仍未明朗。

examples.en: Which way the wind blows may determine whether the plan continues.
examples.zh: 大家的取向可能會決定計劃是否繼續。

specificForms.titleZh: 九、放在句首從屬結構中
specificForms.formula: Before / Once / After / Depending on + clause containing the target
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Before / Once / After / Depending on + clause containing the target.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Before / Once / After / Depending on + clause containing the target。

examples.en: Before we know which way the wind blows, we should avoid announcing a final decision.
examples.zh: 在了解整體取向前，我們不應公布最終決定。

examples.en: Once we see which way the wind blows, we can choose the more suitable plan.
examples.zh: 看清大家的取向後，我們便可以選擇較合適的計劃。

examples.en: Depending on which way the wind blows, the club may keep or cancel the event.
examples.zh: 視乎會員的整體取向，會方可能保留或取消活動。

specificForms.formula: by + V-ing is an optional extension. It is not part of the fixed expression.
specificForms.descriptionEn: How did the person discover which way the wind blows?

examples.en: The coach tried to find out which way the wind blows by speaking to each player privately.
examples.zh: 教練逐一私下與球員交談，嘗試了解他們的整體取向。

examples.en: The coach tried to find out which way the wind blows.
examples.zh: 教練嘗試了解球員的整體取向。

benefits.titleZh: 把群體意見與決策連繫起來
benefits.en: The idiom packages the ideas of observation, changing opinion and later action into one expression.
benefits.zh: 這個慣用語把「觀察」、「意見變化」和「其後行動」集中在一個表達之中。

benefits.en: This sounds natural when there is not yet enough evidence to reach a conclusion.
benefits.zh: 當證據仍然不足以得出結論時，這種說法十分自然。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Useful for Group Decisions
benefits.en: surveys; votes; customer reactions; staff views; class preferences; public opinion; changing trends.
benefits.zh: 這個表達適合用來討論：

benefits.en: The speaker avoids acting too early.
benefits.zh: 說話者避免過早採取行動。

benefits.en: He supports whichever plan is popular because he always waits to see which way the wind blows. The expression can suggest that somebody follows public opinion for personal advantage. The idiom is not automatically better than a plain expression. Use it only when the situation genuinely involves a changing trend, wider opinion or likely direction.
benefits.zh: 他總是先看哪個方案較受歡迎，然後才表示支持，因此他的立場並不堅定。 這個表達可以暗示某人為了個人利益而跟隨主流意見。 慣用語並不一定比一般表達更好。 只有當情境真正涉及轉變中的趨勢、群體意見或可能的發展方向時，才應使用。

origin.statusZh: 逐漸形成；確切來源不明

history.en: A close form appears in John Heywood’s sixteenth-century writing, which refers to knowing which way the wind “blew” and would blow. This shows that the image had been connected with understanding circumstances for centuries.
history.zh: 十六世紀作家 John Heywood 的作品中已出現相近形式，提到知道風過往及將來會向哪邊吹。 這顯示人們數百年前已把風向意象與了解形勢連繫起來。

origin.memoryEn: A small sign shows the direction of an invisible wind; people’s reactions show the direction of an uncertain situation.
origin.memoryZh: 一個小跡象可以顯示看不見的風向；人們的反應則可以顯示尚未明朗的形勢。

rules.titleEn: Use Statement Word Order Inside the Target
rules.titleZh: 規則一：目標表達內使用陳述句語序
rules.zh: 完整句子可以是問句，但嵌入式子句仍保留陳述句語序：

rules.titleEn: The Target Normally Needs a Larger Sentence
rules.titleZh: 規則二：目標表達通常需要放在較大的句子內
rules.en: The target is normally a clause inside a complete statement or question.
rules.zh: 目標表達通常是一個放在完整陳述句或問句內的子句。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse the Target with a Direct Weather
rules.titleZh: 規則三：不要把目標表達與真正的天氣問題混淆
rules.en: Question Which way does the wind blow in winter? Every answer in this exercise must use the figurative meaning.
rules.zh: 不要把目標表達與真正的天氣問題混淆 Literal weather question: 冬天時風向哪邊吹？ 經理希望了解員工的整體取向。 本練習中的所有答案都必須使用比喻意思。

examples.en: The manager wants to know which way the wind blows among the staff.
examples.zh: 經理希望了解員工的整體取向。

rules.titleZh: 規則四：保留不確定程度
rules.en: The source only expresses possibility, not certainty.
rules.zh: 原句只表示可能性，並沒有表示確定。

rules.titleZh: 規則五：保留其後的決定或情境
rules.en: whose opinion matters; what decision is being considered; why the manager needs the information.

rules.titleEn: Do Not Repeat the Idiomatic Meaning
rules.titleZh: 規則六：不要重複慣用語已表達的意思
rules.en: The final clause merely explains the idiom again.
rules.zh: 最後的子句只是再次解釋慣用語。 經理先了解大家的取向，再更改時間表。

examples.en: The manager waited to see which way the wind blows before changing the timetable.
examples.zh: 經理先了解大家的取向，再更改時間表。

rules.titleEn: The Group or Issue May Be Added
rules.titleZh: 規則七：可以補充群體或議題
rules.en: among the staff; among local residents; in the class; within the committee; on the proposed change; before the final vote. These details are not fixed parts of the idiom.
rules.zh: 自然的延伸部分包括： 這些資料並不是慣用語的固定部分。

rules.titleEn: A Common Variant Exists, but It Is Not This
rules.en: A Common Variant Exists, but It Is Not This

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond using the target idiom.
instructions.zh: 使用目標慣用語改寫句子或完成回應。

questions.prompt: Chloe has not chosen Saturday or Sunday for the picnic. She wants to ask all her friends which date they prefer first.
questions.promptZh: 克洛伊尚未決定在星期六還是星期日舉行野餐。她希望先詢問所有朋友較喜歡哪個日期。
questions.answer: Chloe wants to see which way the wind blows among her friends before choosing the picnic date.
questions.answerZh: 克洛伊想先了解朋友們較傾向哪個日期，再決定野餐日期。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: The manager is considering a new staff uniform. She will read the employees’ comments before making the change.
questions.promptZh: 經理正考慮採用新的員工制服。她會先閱讀員工的意見，再作出改動。
questions.answer: Before changing the uniform, the manager will wait to see which way the wind blows among the staff.
questions.answerZh: 經理會先了解員工的整體取向，再更改制服。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: Dad has found two possible places for the family holiday. He wants to learn which place most family members prefer before booking.
questions.promptZh: 爸爸找到了兩個家庭旅行的地點。他希望先了解大部分家庭成員較喜歡哪一個，再作預訂。
questions.answer: Dad wants to know which way the wind blows among the family before booking either holiday.
questions.answerZh: 爸爸希望先了解家庭成員較傾向哪個旅行地點，再作預訂。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: The teacher has three possible topics for the class project. She is asking the students for their views before choosing one.
questions.promptZh: 老師為課堂項目準備了三個可能的題目。她正先詢問學生的意見，再選出其中一個。
questions.answer: The teacher is trying to find out which way the wind blows in the class before choosing the project topic.
questions.answerZh: 老師正嘗試了解班內的整體取向，再選擇項目題目。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: Only four club members have replied about moving the weekly meeting to Saturday. The leader cannot yet judge the general opinion.
questions.promptZh: 目前只有四名會員回覆了有關把每週會議改到星期六的建議。負責人仍無法判斷整體意見。
questions.answer: At this stage, the club leader cannot tell which way the wind blows on moving the meeting to Saturday.
questions.answerZh: 現階段，會方負責人仍無法判斷會員對把會議改到星期六的整體取向。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: The shop has introduced a new drink. The owner will study the first customer comments before ordering a larger amount.
questions.promptZh: 店舖推出了一款新飲品。店主會先研究第一批顧客評論，再決定是否大量入貨。
questions.answer: Early customer comments should show which way the wind blows before the shop orders more of the new drink.
questions.answerZh: 第一批顧客評論應能反映整體取向，讓店舖決定是否增加新飲品的入貨量。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: The café owner is thinking of removing an old lunch set. She will first ask regular customers whether they still order it.
questions.promptZh: 咖啡店店主正考慮取消一款舊午餐。她會先詢問熟客是否仍會點選這款午餐。
questions.answer: Before removing the old lunch set, the café owner wants to know which way the wind blows among regular customers.
questions.answerZh: 在取消舊午餐前，咖啡店店主希望先了解熟客的整體取向。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: The team captain is considering a 7 a.m. training time. He will ask the players what they think before suggesting it officially.
questions.promptZh: 隊長正考慮把訓練時間改為早上七時。他會先詢問球員的意見，再正式提出建議。
questions.answer: The captain will see which way the wind blows in the team before proposing a 7 a.m. training time.
questions.answerZh: 隊長會先了解隊內的整體取向，再建議把訓練時間改為早上七時。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: Our class must choose between visiting a museum and spending a day at the beach. We should hear everyone’s preference first.
questions.promptZh: 我們班需要在參觀博物館和到海灘活動之間作出選擇。我們應先聽取所有人的取向。
questions.answer: We should wait to see which way the wind blows in the class before choosing between the museum and the beach.
questions.answerZh: 我們應先了解班內的整體取向，再在博物館和海灘之間作出選擇。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: The local centre may open an evening class. It has placed a sign-up form online to measure interest before making the final decision.
questions.promptZh: 本地中心可能開辦夜間課程。中心已在網上放置報名表，以在作出最終決定前了解大家的興趣。
questions.answer: The sign-up form should reveal which way the wind blows among local families before the centre opens an evening class.
questions.answerZh: 報名表應能反映本地家庭的整體取向，讓中心決定是否開辦夜間課程。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: The librarian has finished reading a survey about longer weekend opening hours. She now understands what most library users want.
questions.promptZh: 圖書館員已閱讀完有關延長週末開放時間的問卷。她現在明白大部分使用者的取向。
questions.answer: After reading the survey, the librarian now knows which way the wind blows among library users and can decide whether to extend the weekend hours.
questions.answerZh: 閱讀問卷後，圖書館員現在已了解使用者的整體取向，可以決定是否延長週末開放時間。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: Several committee members have not expressed an opinion. Nobody can yet predict which side they are likely to support.
questions.promptZh: 數名委員尚未表達意見。目前沒有人能預測他們較可能支持哪一方。
questions.answer: No one yet knows which way the wind blows among the undecided committee members.
questions.answerZh: 目前仍沒有人知道尚未表態的委員傾向哪一方。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: Parents have given their first reactions to a new homework plan. Ask whether those reactions are enough to show the general opinion.
questions.promptZh: 家長已對新的功課計劃作出初步反應。請詢問這些反應是否足以顯示整體意見。
questions.answer: Can you tell which way the wind blows from the parents’ first reactions to the new homework plan?
questions.answerZh: 你可以從家長對新功課計劃的初步反應，判斷他們的整體取向嗎？
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: Ravi believes most of his colleagues support working from home on Fridays. However, he has spoken to only two people.
questions.promptZh: 拉維認為大部分同事都支持星期五在家工作。然而，他只與兩個人談過。
questions.answer: Ravi thinks he knows which way the wind blows in the office, but he has spoken to only two colleagues.
questions.answerZh: 拉維認為自己知道辦公室內的整體取向，但他只與兩名同事談過。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: The coach will speak to every player privately before deciding whether to appoint a new captain.
questions.promptZh: 教練會逐一私下與球員交談，再決定是否委任新隊長。
questions.answer: By speaking to every player privately, the coach hopes to find out which way the wind blows before deciding whether to appoint a new captain.
questions.answerZh: 教練會逐一私下與球員交談，希望在決定是否委任新隊長前了解他們的整體取向。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: Local residents discussed the proposed parking rules at yesterday’s meeting. Their comments helped us understand the general attitude more clearly.
questions.promptZh: 本地居民在昨天的會議上討論了建議中的泊車規則。他們的意見令我們更清楚了解整體態度。
questions.answer: Yesterday’s meeting gave us a clearer idea of which way the wind blows among residents on the proposed parking rules.
questions.answerZh: 昨天的會議令我們更清楚了解居民對建議中泊車規則的整體取向。
questions.targetMeaning: To understand the general direction in which a situation, public opinion or a group’s preference is developing, especially before deciding what to do.

questions.prompt: The shop is considering whether to continue opening late. Its choice may be influenced by the opinions of customers who visit in the evening.
